method: Each run compares every period the source returned with the previous public/data/history file for that series. A change in the value at the number of decimals Veritane shows is recorded. Fixings such as exchange reference rates and projections are not compared.

entries.name: Cash rate target
entries.text: Australia, Cash rate target: Veritane switched to a different source dataset (F1 FIRMMCRTD) on 7 November 2026. Figures before that date come from the earlier dataset.
entries.text_simple: Veritane now takes these figures from a different dataset (F1 FIRMMCRTD). The change was made on 7 November 2026.
